# Button Plumbing LLC
> Licensed plumber in Siletz, Oregon serving Lincoln County since 2003.

## Overview
Button Plumbing LLC is a licensed plumbing contractor based in Siletz, Oregon. The company was established in December 2003 and is led by David Roy Button. Button Plumbing holds Oregon Construction Contractors Board license #158113 and is BBB Accredited with an A+ rating (accredited since 2018).

## Services
- Plumbing Repair (leaks, pipes, fixtures, faucets, toilets)
- Water Heater Repair, Maintenance, and Replacement
- Drain and Sewer Service (clearing, repair, troubleshooting)
- Plumbing Installation (new fixtures, supply lines, additions)
- Remodel Plumbing (kitchen and bathroom remodels)
- Pump Systems (well pump and water pump installation and service)
- Commercial Plumbing
- Residential Plumbing

## Service Area
Lincoln County, Oregon including:
- Siletz (headquarters)
- Newport
- Lincoln City
- Toledo
- Depoe Bay
